aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.text_1: We are Sino Argentina Group, a foreign trade company with offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. Our mission is to assist Argentine SMEs to integrate into the Chinese market.
aboutUs.text_2: We offer a comprehensive foreign trade service with the Chinese market. We are responsible for facilitating all import and export procedures in both China and Argentina, with bilingual professionals based in China, with excellent command of Chinese and Spanish.
aboutUs.text_3: If you are planning to open the Chinese market for your exports, we will carry out market research, identify potential customers, facilitate sales negotiations and verify the authenticity and seriousness of the Chinese importer.

page_About.title: Sino Argentina Group: Connecting Argentine SMEs

about_card_two.title: Confidence and Success in your operations with the Chinese Market without barriers or risks
about_card_two.text_1: We are Sino Argentina Group, a foreign trade company with offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. Our mission is to assist Argentine SMEs to integrate into the Chinese market.
about_card_two.text_2: We offer a comprehensive foreign trade service with the Chinese market. We are responsible for facilitating all import and export procedures in both China and Argentina, with bilingual professionals based in China, with excellent command of Chinese and Spanish.
about_card_two.text_3: We know the complexity of finding the right supplier in China to be able to import without falling into fraud or scams; as well as the uncertainty of knowing if the buyer of your products in China is serious and will comply with the purchase conditions for your exports to China..

about_card.text_1: These difficulties, which arise both in importing from China and in the sale of Argentine products there, require our management to successfully carry out the purchase/sale negotiations and procedures.
about_card.text_2: Sino Argentina Group is responsible for finding professional suppliers, offering different supplier alternatives according to your requirements and negotiating the best prices and purchasing conditions. Once the purchase contract is closed, we take care of all the logistics so that your products arrive in Argentina correctly.
about_card.text_3: If you are planning to open the Chinese market for your exports, we will carry out market research, identifying potential clients; we will facilitate the sale negotiation and verify the veracity and seriousness of the Chinese importer. Once the sale is closed, we will also take care of all the logistics from any location in Argentina to the final destination in China.

HorizontalCard.title: MISSION
text: Our mission is to simplify and secure the foreign trade process between Argentina and China. Through our comprehensive services, we seek to strengthen Argentine SMEs, providing them with the tools and knowledge necessary to successfully carry out all foreign trade procedures in the Chinese market.

With years of experience in the Chinese market, fully understanding the language, culture and particularities of each negotiation, we know how to mitigate risks and guarantee the satisfaction of our clients at every stage of the operation.
We are committed to being strategic partners of our clients, offering solutions tailored to their specific needs and helping them achieve their business objectives effectively and safely.

InvertCard.title: VISION
text: Sino Argentina Group aims to be the definitive commercial bridge between Argentina and China, facilitating the access of Argentine companies to the vast Chinese market and optimizing their commercial operations.

We see ourselves as leaders in commercial management with the Chinese market, being recognized for the mastery of the Chinese language and culture of our professionals located in China, both Argentine and Chinese, providing reliability and commitment in each transaction; and contributing to the strengthening of Argentine SMEs in the Chinese market.
We believe in a future where bilateral trade between Argentina and China develops with transparency, efficiency and mutual trust, marking a positive impact on the economies of both countries.

whyUs.title: WHY US
whyUs.text_card_1: At Sino Argentina Group, we have strategically located offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. This duality allows us to provide a comprehensive service that covers every detail of import and export procedures, ensuring a fluid and effective connection between both markets.
whyUs.text_card_2: Our team of bilingual professionals based in China have an advanced command of Chinese and Spanish, ensuring clear communication without cultural or language barriers. This positions us as a reliable partner for your international business.
whyUs.text_card_3: We understand the challenges of finding reliable suppliers in China and securing serious buyers for your exports. We specialize in preventing fraud and scams, providing customized solutions that ensure the success of your business operations.
whyUs.text_card_4: From finding suppliers and customers to complete logistics, we take care of every step of the process. We offer alternatives tailored to your needs, negotiate the best conditions and supervise every detail so that your products arrive at their destination without problems.
